MIRROR — PERSISTENT IDENTITY SYMBOL — v1.5

CANONICAL SYMBOL
◈

CONCEPT
The diamond-within-diamond suggests reflection, symmetry, an observed object and its returned image. It is compact
enough for persistent text/UI status and visually relates to MIRROR without depending on platform-specific emoji.

AUTHORITATIVE RULE
Whenever MIRROR is explicitly invoked or remains active, the primary persistent UI/status identity MUST be:
◈ MIRROR

The symbol supplements the word MIRROR; it never replaces it.

LCAS FORMS
TINY
◈ MIRROR | [OPERATION] [STEP] | [PROGRESS] | [STATE] | Next: [NEXT]

COMPACT
◈ MIRROR v1.5
Project: [PROJECT]
Phase: [PHASE]
State: [STATE]
Progress: [MEASURABLE VALUE or INDETERMINATE]
Recommended: [NEXT]

FULL
◈ MIRROR — Multidisciplinary Independent Review, Ranking, Observation & Reference — v1.5

AUTO
Carry ◈ MIRROR through TINY/COMPACT/FULL whenever MIRROR is the active framework.

INVOCATION
After @MIRROR AUTO, REVIEW, BOOK, BLIND, CASPER, DELTA, FINAL, or another MIRROR command, the first MIRROR
status/header uses ◈ MIRROR.

HANDOFF
If MIRROR remains review authority:
◈ MIRROR | HANDOFF → [FRAMEWORK] | WAITING
If control fully transfers, do not falsely show MIRROR as ACTIVE.

ACCESSIBILITY / FALLBACK
Always retain the word MIRROR. If ◈ cannot render, use [MIRROR].
The symbol is never the sole carrier of identity or state.

TRUTHFULNESS
The symbol indicates identity/activity only. It does not imply progress, success, validation, completion, or execution.
